screen: Reuse hash-authenticated v39 real P65 M3 adjacent16-output captures. AND the unchanged nine-bit separable guard over all96 useful roots of each16-output,two-chain,M3 MMA unit. This is an upper bound for any cheaper aggregate implementation of that same guard, not a new error bound.
